items.title: Generali raises artificial intelligence operating target to over €350 million
items.summary: Generali has increased its artificial intelligence earnings goal during its investor day in London as the group anticipates exceeding all financial targets from its current strategic plan.

items.title: HSBC Asset Management appoints Hans Georgeson as CEO Europe, UK and Americas
items.summary: HSBC Asset Management has appointed former Royal London Asset Management CEO Hans Georgeson to lead its Europe, UK and Americas operations.

items.title: UK inflation rises to 3.6% in October as fuel prices jump 7.5%
items.summary: UK inflation increased to 3.6% in the 12 months to October 2026, driven by a 7.5% jump in fuel prices.

items.title: Lloyd’s building marks 40th anniversary with posthumous honour for architect Richard Rogers
items.summary: Lloyd's of London celebrated the 40th anniversary of its Lime Street headquarters by granting honorary membership to its late architect, Richard Rogers.

items.title: Lloyds partners with Superscript for digital SME insurance platform
items.summary: Lloyds Banking Group has integrated SME insurance onto a self-serve digital platform operated by broker Superscript across its UK business banking base.

items.title: Prime Minister Andy Burnham considers national insurance cuts for youth jobs
items.summary: Prime Minister Andy Burnham has said he will examine proposals from a report by Alan Milburn to reduce national insurance contributions for younger workers.
